statements: CREATE TABLE audit.users (id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, amount NUMERIC(10,2) DEFAULT 0 CHECK (amount >= 0), doubled NUMERIC GENERATED ALWAYS AS (amount * 2) STORED, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE audit.events (id BIGSERIAL, user_id BIGINT REFERENCES audit.users(id), happened_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, payload JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, PRIMARY KEY (id, happened_at)) PARTITION BY RANGE (happened_at);
CREATE TABLE audit.events_2026 PARTITION OF audit.events FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-01-01') TO ('2027-01-01');
CREATE INDEX idx_users_code ON audit.users USING btree (code);
ALTER TABLE audit.users ADD COLUMN enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true;
CREATE VIEW audit.active_users AS SELECT id, code FROM audit.users WHERE enabled;
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW audit.counts AS SELECT user_id, count(*) AS n FROM audit.events GROUP BY user_id WITH NO DATA;
CREATE TYPE audit.state AS ENUM ('new', 'done');
CREATE DOMAIN audit.positive AS integer CHECK (VALUE > 0);
CREATE SEQUENCE audit.ticket_seq START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
CREATE POLICY user_read ON audit.users FOR SELECT USING (enabled);
COMMENT ON TABLE audit.users IS 'users; active';
CREATE FUNCTION audit.one() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC SELECT 1; END;
CREATE FUNCTION audit.two() RETURNS integer AS $fn$ BEGIN RETURN 2; END $fn$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE FUNCTION audit.three() RETURNS integer AS 'SELECT 1; SELECT 3' LANGUAGE sql;
CREATE PROCEDURE audit.refresh_counts() LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW audit.counts; END;
CREATE TRIGGER tr_users BEFORE INSERT ON audit.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.touch();

CREATE RULE duplicate_event AS ON INSERT TO audit.users DO ALSO (INSERT INTO audit.events(user_id,happened_at) VALUES (NEW.id,now()); INSERT INTO audit.events(user_id,happened_at) VALUES (NEW.id,now()));
DO $body$ BEGIN RAISE NOTICE 'a; b'; PERFORM 1; END $body$;
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT id FROM audit.users WHERE enabled;
WITH RECURSIVE nums(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM nums WHERE n < 3) SELECT n FROM nums;

SELECT u.id, x.n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.user_id IS NOT NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY e.id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM audit.users u CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 AS n) x LEFT JOIN audit.events e ON e.user_id = u.id;
SELECT payload->'a', payload->>'a', payload#>'{a,b}', payload @> '{"a":1}'::jsonb, payload ? 'a', payload ?| array['a','b'] FROM audit.events;
INSERT INTO audit.users(code) VALUES ('x') ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET amount = EXCLUDED.amount RETURNING id;
ALTER TABLE audit.users ALTER COLUMN amount SET DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE audit.users ADD CONSTRAINT ck_code CHECK (length(code) > 0);
MERGE INTO audit.users u USING (SELECT 'x' AS code) s ON u.code = s.code WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET enabled = true WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (code) VALUES (s.code);
